title: Arabic numbers and greetings
examples: How do I say hello in Arabic?
What is the number two in Arabic?
Can you teach me how to say thank you?

explain.say: Today we will learn some basic Arabic words. We will learn how to count and how to say thank you.
The word for one in Arabic is wahid. Say it with me slowly. wahid means the number one.
The word for two in Arabic is ithnan. It is a little different from wahid. ithnan means the number two.
To say thank you in Arabic, we use the word shukran. It is a very polite thing to know. shukran means thank you.
Let us look at the Arabic numerals. The number one is written as one symbol. The number two is written as another symbol.
Imagine you are receiving a gift from a friend. You should say thank you in Arabic. You would say shukran to them.

faq.q: How do I say thank you in Arabic?
faq.a: You say shukran. It is a very common and polite phrase to use.
asks: What is the Arabic word for thanks?
Can you teach me the thank you phrase?

faq.q: What is the Arabic word for one?
faq.a: The word for one is wahid. You can use it when counting things.
asks: How do you say the number one?
What is the Arabic word for 1?

faq.q: How do I say two in Arabic?
faq.a: You say ithnan. It follows the pattern of counting numbers.
asks: What is the Arabic word for 2?
Can I use ithnan for two things?

faq.q: Do the Arabic numerals look different from English?
faq.a: Yes, they have their own unique symbols. You must learn to recognize these symbols.
asks: Are the Arabic numbers the same?
How do I write the number two in Arabic?

faq.q: Are these words used only in Arabic speaking countries?
faq.a: No, these are basic phrases learned in language study. They are useful everywhere.
asks: Can I use this phrase anywhere?

facts: Wahid means the number one in Arabic.
Ithnan means the number two in Arabic.
Shukran is the standard way to say thank you.
Arabic numerals have their own distinct writing system.

quiz.say: If you receive a present, what should you say in Arabic?
quiz.why: Shukran is the correct word for 'thank you' in Arabic.

wrong.0: Hello is a greeting, but not the word for thank you.
wrong.2: Wahid means the number one, not thank you.
wrong.3: Ithnan means the number two, not thank you.

quiz.say: What is the Arabic word for the number one?
quiz.why: Wahid is the specific Arabic word used for the number one.

wrong.0: Shukran means thank you, not one.
wrong.1: One is the English word, not the Arabic word.
wrong.3: Ithnan is the word for two, not one.

quiz.say: If you count two objects, which Arabic word do you use?
quiz.why: Ithnan is the correct Arabic word used when counting up to two.

wrong.0: Wahid is used only when counting the number one.
wrong.1: Shukran has nothing to do with counting numbers.
wrong.2: Two is the English word, not the Arabic word.
